reviews.classification: unexecuted acceptance matrix with qualified future use
reviews.disposition: M01–M08, D01–D08, Q01–Q12, P01–P10 and U01–U05 are specified NOT RUN cases. Preserve the meaningful failure invariants: independent identity/address/physical fields, no accidental healing or enrollment, no cumulative modifiers, exact owned costs and rollback, real downstream body consumers, literal-file import and hidden-effect-safe projection. Prototype percentages/profile tables, health floors and ordinary pursuit examples are pinned scenarios, not all-world physiology or immunity to stronger means. Legacy conversion rows are optional under current compatibility direction. Fresh creation does not authorize reviving the deferred public start picker. Historical viewport/font assumptions yield to current UI rules; browser-local presentation has its own persistence owner. No test, fixture or body feature was executed by this review.
reviews.evidence: Complete original test plan, setup, all case bodies and later rule qualifications read in bounded ranges. This is review of planned assertions, not running them or reading all linked specifications.
reviews.reopen: Select meaningful cases only for an authorized changed consumer or reproduced defect; retain NOT RUN until exact candidate evidence is recorded.

reviews.classification: unexecuted acceptance matrix with qualified future use
reviews.disposition: P01–P13, X01–X12, N01–N07/U01–U02 and R01–R10 remain NOT RUN. Keep exact unit custody/escrow, frozen cause/result, performed-work cancellation, same body/edit settlement, trained-source preservation, current-state literal import and useful packing downstream action. Somatic versus engineered germline versus inherited snapshot remain distinct; pure conception/allele fixtures are not native birth. Source-note unread sample provenance stays unknown. Prototype load triples, 10000 outcome bands, fee/duration and cap-one benefit belong to this selected candidate model, not universal body rules or a reason to refuse superior supported means. A paid-vial route does not prove hunt/stabilization, and forced positive draws remain seeded proof. The named fixture list was proposed, not created. Use current AD41 write ownership and required gates when a slice is authorized, not an automatic isolated-worktree or all-scenarios prerequisite.

reviews.classification: unexecuted acceptance matrix with qualified future use
reviews.disposition: S1–S12, N1–N9, P1–P9 and L1–L3 remain NOT RUN. Preserve knowledge precision/scope/confidence/stage distinctions, attributed conflicting reports, known versus hidden change, body/clock/unit binding, durable enable, native useful reading, source delivery and no truth-based ordering/count leak. A passing synthetic canary tests that sentinel only; it does not certify all secrets. Private native saves must retain necessary opaque state while public reports remain observer-projected; secrecy is not encryption or truncation. Device tab preference does not enable a gameplay lens and is not proven by game-file import. Generic cheat-host commit-before-refresh inspection in B84 is not CV1’s own validator, first enable, rollback, native acquisition, persistence or leak proof. Historical card counts are catalogue-fixture expectations, not a new current inventory. Keep C0/CH1/R1 prerequisites scoped to the actual selected receiver.
